benchmark-real-run-05.title: The Returned Key
benchmark-real-run-05.script_text:
Dusk. Wide static two-shot. Nina guards the key; Jules waits. Tense silence.
Dusk. Medium close-up of Nina on left looking right at Jules. She hesitates; key stays beside red mug.
Dusk. Reverse medium close-up of Jules on right, looking left toward Nina, quietly hopeful.
Dusk. Table insert. Nina slides the brass key left to right toward Jules. Bandaged left wrist visible; red mug stays still.
Dusk. Static two-shot. Jules holds the returned brass key on right. Nina exhales on left; tension eases. Mug stays on table.
Later, night outside the right window. Same static two-shot and amber lamp. Jules holds key, Nina rests her bandaged wrist. Quiet trust.
